description: This file implements Bluetooth Mesh transport layer functions, including segmentation, reassembly, encryption, and message handling for the Zephyr project.

methods.name: send_unseg
methods.description: Handles sending unsegmented Bluetooth Mesh messages, including queueing for Friend nodes if applicable.

methods.name: seg_tx_in_progress
methods.description: Checks if any segmented transmission is currently in progress.

methods.name: seg_tx_done
methods.description: Marks a segment transmission as completed and frees associated buffer.

methods.name: seg_tx_blocks
methods.description: Checks if a segment transmission matches given source and destination addresses.

methods.name: seg_tx_unblock_check
methods.description: Unblocks any blocked transmission with matching parameters.

methods.name: seg_tx_reset
methods.description: Resets a segment transmission context, cancelling timers and freeing buffers.

methods.name: seg_tx_complete
methods.description: Finalizes a segment transmission, invoking callback and resetting context.

methods.name: schedule_transmit_continue
methods.description: Schedules continuation of segment transmission after a delay.

methods.name: seg_send_start
methods.description: Callback to start segment transmission, invoking user callback.

methods.name: seg_sent
methods.description: Callback invoked after a segment is sent, scheduling retransmission if needed.

methods.name: seg_tx_buf_build
methods.description: Builds a buffer for a segment transmission.

methods.name: seg_tx_send_unacked
methods.description: Resends unacknowledged segments, handling retries and scheduling retransmission timers.

methods.name: seg_retransmit
methods.description: Work handler for retransmitting unacknowledged segments.

methods.name: send_seg
methods.description: Handles segmented message transmission, including buffer allocation and queueing.

methods.name: trans_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a message for transmission using the specified key.

methods.name: bt_mesh_trans_send
methods.description: Main function to send a Bluetooth Mesh message, handling segmentation and encryption.

methods.name: seg_rx_assemble
methods.description: Reassembles segments into a complete SDU.

methods.name: sdu_try_decrypt
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt a received SDU, handling virtual addresses.

methods.name: sdu_recv
methods.description: Processes received SDU, decrypts, and passes to model layer.

methods.name: seg_tx_lookup
methods.description: Finds a segment transmission context based on SeqZero, OBO, and address.

methods.name: trans_ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment messages for segmented transmissions.

methods.name: ctl_recv
methods.description: Processes control messages such as heartbeats and friendship operations.

methods.name: trans_unseg
methods.description: Processes unsegmented incoming messages.

methods.name: bt_mesh_ctl_send
methods.description: Sends a control message, either segmented or unsegmented.

methods.name: send_ack
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment for segmented messages.

methods.name: seg_rx_reset
methods.description: Resets a segment receive context, freeing buffers and timers.

methods.name: seg_discard
methods.description: Handles timeout for incomplete segment reception.

methods.name: seg_ack
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment for received segments, scheduling retries.

methods.name: seg_rx_find
methods.description: Finds a segment receive context matching given source and SeqAuth.

methods.name: seg_rx_is_valid
methods.description: Validates a received segment against ongoing session.

methods.name: seg_rx_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new segment receive context.

methods.name: trans_seg
methods.description: Processes incoming segmented message, handling reassembly and flow control.
